statements: THE MAC FULL SUITE AND DOCKER PORTABLE SUITE USED THE SAME EXACT-SHA SOURCE ARCHIVE AND FINGERPRINT.
DOCKER EXCLUSIONS WERE LIMITED TO MECHANICALLY PROVEN HOST-DEPENDENT TESTS THAT EXECUTED ON THE MAC.
A PASS REQUIRES BOTH THE MAC AND DOCKER LAYERS TO PASS.
MAC AND DOCKER TOTALS IN THIS PACKET ARE PARSED FROM THE COMMITTED RAW LOGS, EACH BOUND BY SHA-256.
digest_canonicalization: sha256(JSON.stringify(object minus its own digest field), UTF-8, keys in insertion order; content is ASCII-only so UTF-8 and ascii-escaped forms are byte-identical)
